messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: us-west-2 — sudden tail latency spike + kernel fallback after ongoing prefetch rollout. p95 from ~120ms -> ~480ms, errors up ~3.2% on embed endpoints. Auto-page to @eva :rotating_light:

 eva: on it. how big is the rollout and which pools are impacted?

 samir: canary at 25% across slice-3 and slice-7. only slice-7 showing repeated kernel-fallback logs and batch drain. early guess: prefetch-v2 is causing eviction churn and KV cache thrash -> runtime falling back to legacy kernel under load.

 lucas: paste logs from a failing worker:

 ```
[2026-03-15T14:07:02Z] WARN kernel: kv-evict loop detected, evict_count=312
[2026-03-15T14:07:02Z] INFO runtime: switching to fallback-kernel (reason: kv_thrash)
[2026-03-15T14:07:02Z] ERROR batcher: ongoing batch split, active_batches=0 -> high tail
```

 elena: Support note — customers on us-west-2: acct:acme-payments, acct:streamly, acct:edutech-1 report higher latencies and some 502s on embedding calls. ops page showing increased retry storms.

 eva: cool. quick mitigation plan: 1) toggle kill-flag for prefetch-v2 to stop rollout, 2) drain slice-7 traffic to fallback pool, 3) if not recovering in 10m, rollback canary. who can flip kill-flag now?

 samir: I can flip. quick toggle (feature-flip service):

 ```
# curl to feature service
curl -X POST https://feature.internal/v1/toggles/prefetch-v2 -d '{"enabled":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SVC_TOKEN'
```

 samir: doing the flip now.

 deploy-bot: ACTION: feature toggle prefetch-v2 set to false by samir at 2026-03-15T14:09:12Z. Canary rollout paused.

 lucas: after toggling, observed fallback kernel counts drop and active batchers start to rebuild. but KV evictions still occasionally spike for 2-3 hosts. recommending immediate traffic slice move off slice-7 to slice-2.

 eva: samir, can you start a traffic reroute for slice-7? reduce to 0% and spread to healthy pools. use the routing-service command.

 samir: running:

 ```
# route traffic away from slice-7
routingctl move --from slice-7 --to slice-2,slice-4 --pct 100 --dry-run=false
```

 samir: routing change applied. monitoring.

 support-ops: ETA for customer-facing note? we should give an ETA and impact numbers.

 elena: draft: "We experienced increased latency and errors for some requests in us-west-2 due to a canary rollout of a prefetch optimization. We have paused the rollout and shifted traffic; service health is recovering. Investigating root cause and will follow up." thumbs? :+1:

 samir: quick numbers from metrics: p95 went from 120ms -> 480ms at spike; after killflag + reroute p95 around 140ms within 7m. error rate (4xx/5xx) peaked at 3.2% then fell to 0.4%. throughput dropped ~18% during peak.

 lucas: host-level: 3 hosts had repeated evictions and then OOM-ish behavior within kernel fallback loop — we've marked them for reprovision.

 eva: good. i'll initiate rollback for prefetch-v2 entirely from canary and stop any scheduled batches for next 30m. samir, coordinate rollback with deploy-bot.

 deploy-bot: ROLLBACK: prefetch-v2 canary rollback initiated by eva at 2026-03-15T14:18:03Z. starting canary abort and full-stage revert. Estimated time 9m.

 support-ops: I'll publish the first status update to the status page and ping top 5 affected customers with the draft.

 elena: providing impact matrix to support: acct:acme-payments (high), acct:streamly (medium), acct:edutech-1 (low). We'll offer incident follow-up call if needed.

 lucas: post-rollback metrics: p95 stable ~125ms, tail dip still slightly elevated on a couple hosts; evictions down to baseline. throughput back to ~98% of normal after 12m.

 eva: marking incident as mitigated. immediate actions: 1) postmortem runbook, 2) repro of eviction locally with prefetched workload, 3) add automated pre-check for eviction thrash in future rollouts, 4) improve kill-flag runbook so SREs can hit faster.

 support-ops: customer updates sent. will compile replies and escalate any requests.

 incident-bot: RESOLVED: Incident mitigated at 2026-03-15T14:27:12Z. Root cause investigation assigned to eng-runtime (samir, lucas). Severity: SEV2 (customer-impacting).

 eva: thanks all. postmortem assigned to samir. please add timeline and config diff for prefetch-v2.

 samir: will take. uploading logs and a minimal repro in the postmortem ticket.

 elena: closing loop with support in 24h and sharing RCA once ready. :white_check_mark:
